primitives.name: Mind-to-Engine Consumption Boundary
primitives.verbatim_quote: # MIND-TO-ENGINE CONSUMPTION BOUNDARY (Motif, 2026-11-07) Question: can the mind staging corpus feed the equation gate — i.e., is there any path from a staging record to a game context the gate can evaluate?
primitives.assumptions: No adapter from staging records to game_ctx exists.
primitives.breakdown_regime: No code path connects the mind corpus to the gate.

layer2.mapping: The boundary represents an anti-collinearity between two distinct data domains: the trainer-ready textual staging records and the numeric game_ctx expected by the equation gate. This separation prevents direct consumption of the mind's output by the engine.
layer2.telemetry: Verification metric: absence of any function f : staging_record → game_ctx in the current repository.

primitives.name: Staging Record Families
primitives.verbatim_quote: Record schemas across all 13 staging files (14,040 lines) fall into a few families: text records (id/kind/source/title/text/trainer_ready, some with reasoning_track + weekly_cycle_step), document-chunk records (content + sha256), file-inventory records (510, with equations_and_premises summaries), and runtime stream records (the TNF aggregator).
primitives.assumptions: The staging records are primarily textual and metadata-oriented.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Schema heterogeneity precludes direct integration with the gate's numeric expectations.

layer2.mapping: The staging record families form a sub-algebra within the broader repository algebra, isomorphic to a knowledge representation layer but incompatible with the GSI/GSE operational algebras that require numeric game_ctx inputs.
layer2.telemetry: Observable: the distinct data types (textual vs. numeric) in the staging versus the gate's input requirements.

primitives.name: Zero Game-State Fields
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Zero records carry flat game-state fields** (off_epa / def_epa / pressure_rate / proe_pct / spread / total), and none carries a game_ctx object.
primitives.assumptions: The staging records lack the structured numeric fields required for direct consumption by the equation gate.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Absence of game_ctx objects creates a fundamental mismatch.

layer2.mapping: This primitive defines a derived kernel of failure: the staging records' inability to provide the minimal necessary input (game_ctx) for the gate's evaluation. It is a consequence of the universal lens constraint that no adapter exists.
layer2.telemetry: Direct telemetry: count of game-state fields present in staging records versus required by the gate.

primitives.name: Corpus Is Trainer-Ready
primitives.verbatim_quote: The corpus is trainer-ready text; the gate eats numeric game state.
primitives.assumptions: The trainer-ready text is semantically rich but structurally incompatible with the gate's numeric demands.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Semantic richness does not imply syntactic compatibility.

layer2.mapping: The trainer-ready text establishes an isomorphism with human coach decision-making processes, while the gate's numeric game state establishes an isomorphism with automated equation evaluation. The boundary prevents these isomorphisms from composing.
layer2.telemetry: Verification: the corpus remains unchanged while the gate's interface remains fixed.
